title: Point-of-care Testing of Respiratory Pathogens at Pediatric Emergency Room
brief_summary: The main objective of the trial is to evaluate the effect of point-of-care testing of respiratory pathogens at a pediatric emergency room on the antibiotic consumption and hospital admissions in acutely ill children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any respiratory symptom defined as tachypnea, shortness of breath, apnea, wheezing, cough, rhinitis, croup, sneezing, ear ache, or sore throat AND/OR
* Fever \> 38.0 C

Exclusion Criteria:

* Need of resuscitation at emergency room
* Need of immediate transfer to pediatric intensive care unit
